title: Biefeld affidavit confirming anomalous effect

tellings.quote: Paul Biefeld. They say he never met Paul Biefeld and then this affidavit comes out later. Paul Biefeld definitely met Townsend Brown.

plain: The inventor Townsend Brown really did work with the physicist Paul Alfred Biefeld on a strange electrical effect that seemed to push objects, even though critics say the two never met. Paul Schatzkin, who wrote about Brown's life, says a sworn statement from Biefeld came out later and settles it: "Paul Biefeld definitely met Townsend Brown." If so, the story behind Brown's claimed discovery holds up.
